key_stats: Military exercise in Pasadena: public informed only 6 minutes before the announcement (text sent at 5:24 p.m. for a 5:30 p.m. announcement)
Rick Cole reached nearly 8 million people with his videos informing the public about the military exercise
Houlton Regional Hospital closed its labor and delivery unit with only one month's notice
Katie Gowell's prolapsed cord emergency occurred 29 days after Houlton closed its labor and delivery department
Best practice for a prolapsed cord: patient should be in surgery within 5 to 10 minutes — Dr. Fuchs maintained her position for nearly 90 minutes
Normal fetal heart rate is 120 to 160 beats per minute; during surgery the baby's heart rate dropped to 90, which Dr. Shearheart described as a signal of impending disaster

pending_qa.q: How was Katie Gowell's baby ultimately delivered and who performed the emergency C-section?
pending_qa.r: Dr. Monica Shearheart, an OB-GYN who was on call at Houlton and sleeping at the nearby Ivy's Motor Lodge, was woken by a phone call and came to the hospital. She argued successfully that the C-section should be performed at Houlton rather than airlifting Katie to Eastern Maine Medical Center in Bangor. Former OB nurses who had worked in the now-closed labor and delivery unit volunteered and rushed in to assist. Dr. Fuchs remained in position throughout the surgery, with surgical drapes thrown over her and instruments rested on her back, until the baby was delivered.

pending_qa.q: What were the physical conditions Dr. Rose Fuchs endured during the nearly 90-minute prolapsed cord intervention?
pending_qa.r: Dr. Fuchs, who has scoliosis, maintained an intense kneeling and crouching position with her hand inserted up to her forearm inside the patient for approximately 90 minutes, through a bumpy ambulance ride on back roads and into the operating room. Her legs fell asleep, her hand went intermittently numb — worrying her that she might be pinching the cord — and she described the position as physically excruciating. During the surgery, iodine was poured over her arm, surgical tools were placed on her back, and her cheek lay on Katie's thigh with her head in an air pocket under the surgical drape.
